standard.name: Standard Nuzlocke
rules: Any Pokemon that faints is considered dead and must be released or permanently boxed in the PC.
You may only catch the very first wild Pokemon encountered in each new route or area.
All caught Pokemon must be nicknamed to build an emotional bond.
No level caps or in-battle item bans apply by default.

hardcore.name: Hardcore Nuzlocke
rules: Any Pokemon that faints is considered dead and must be released or permanently boxed in the PC.
You may only catch the very first wild Pokemon encountered in each new route or area.
All caught Pokemon must be nicknamed.
No items may be used from the bag during battle (held items are allowed).
Battle style must be set to SET mode.
Gym Level Cap: Your Pokemon cannot exceed the highest level of the next Gym Leader's Pokemon before challenging that Gym.
Elite Four Level Cap: Before entering the Elite Four, your Pokemon cannot exceed level 55 (Drake's highest-level Pokemon). This cap applies to all four Elite Four battles.
Champion Level Cap: Before challenging Champion Wallace, your Pokemon cannot exceed level 58.

optional_clauses.Dupes Clause: If your first encounter in an area is a species (or evolutionary line) you have already caught, you may re-roll the encounter.
optional_clauses.Shiny Clause: If you encounter a Shiny Pokemon, you may catch and use it even if it is not your first encounter in that area.
optional_clauses.Gift & Static Clause: Gift Pokemon (such as Castform or Wynaut Egg) and static encounters (such as Kecleon or Sudowoodo) may be counted separately or as the encounter for that location depending on player preference.
